name: hypertask_pages
does: Create, read, update, list or search ticket pages, and inspect, restore or archive their versions.
use_when: Use for longer documents attached to tickets; get with format retrieves the current page content.
do_not_use_when: Do not use for conversation replies or ticket descriptions; use hypertask_comments or hypertask_tasks instead.
parameters_and_caveats: action selects an operation; input contains only that operation’s documented fields. response_format defaults to concise for reads; detailed retains full fields. limit defaults to 20 (maximum 50) and offset defaults to 0 for bounded read results; use returned pagination or narrower filters. page_id or id identifies a page; update supports if_version for optimistic concurrency. Concise reads summarize pages; request detailed for full content.
